Name: Serpent Tongue
Description:
You transform your tongue into a poisonous serpent for the duration. When you cast this spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 piercing damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of you.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.
